to: the socket that went above its call-cost limit only

fields.name: calls
fields.description: `socket.calls`: the calls of the last 4 s, oldest first, with the call that went above the limit.

fields.name: climit
fields.description: The limit that the socket went above. After a normal call: 200 with a character, 50 without one (node/server.js:4905). After a handler error: always 200.

fields.name: total
fields.description: `socket.total_calls`: the number of events that this socket sent since it connected.

fields.name: method
fields.description: Only after a handler error: the event name, up to 200 characters. A handler error adds a cost of 16 (node/server.js:4950).

senders.what: The wrapper of every handler, when the call cost goes above the limit before the handler runs. `disconnect_reason` `"limitdc"` follows, then the disconnect.
The same wrapper, when a handler throws an error and the cost goes above 200. This form has `method`.
